MATCH (o:Owner)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document)
WITH DISTINCT o,
  CAST(split_part(o.birth_date, ', ', 2) AS INT64) AS birth_year,
  CASE split_part(o.birth_date, ' ', 1)
    WHEN 'January' THEN 1 WHEN 'February' THEN 2 WHEN 'March' THEN 3
    WHEN 'April' THEN 4 WHEN 'May' THEN 5 WHEN 'June' THEN 6
    WHEN 'July' THEN 7 WHEN 'August' THEN 8 WHEN 'September' THEN 9
    WHEN 'October' THEN 10 WHEN 'November' THEN 11 WHEN 'December' THEN 12
  END AS birth_month,
  CAST(split_part(split_part(o.birth_date, ' ', 2), ',', 1) AS INT64) AS birth_day
WITH o,
  CASE
    WHEN o.birth_date IS NULL THEN NULL

      ELSE 0
    END

WHERE age < 65 OR o.nationality <> 'Israeli-American'
